variance_reduction_mechanism_explanation: Total simulated race time decomposes into: T = T_base + Delta_exogenous(SC, Weather) + Delta_tactical(Policy). Because random neutralisations shift race time by 30-150s, the variance of Delta_exogenous exceeds 1.1x10^6 s^2. Under independent draws, Var(T_A - T_B) = Var(T_A) + Var(T_B) ≈ 2.26x10^6 s^2. Under Common Random Numbers, Delta_exogenous is identical between policies and cancels out, leaving only Var(Delta_tactical) ≈ 60 s^2. This produces a ~99.997% variance reduction in race-time difference and ~92% variance reduction in finishing position difference across all master seeds.
marginal_equivalence_wording_standard: Failure to reject H0 (p >= 0.05 across all 5 seeds) indicates no statistically detectable marginal distribution difference in the tested samples, satisfying practical equivalence tolerance Delta_equiv <= 0.060, rather than a mathematical proof of absolute identity.
